AGREEMENT FOR THE SALE OF A USED CAR

This Private Sale Agreement is made on 20 October 2026 between the following parties:

1. The Seller: Priya Patel, date of birth 1998-02-21, residing at 54 Elm Grove, York YO8 7DA.

2. The Buyer: Mia Fairbanks, residing at 159 Mill Road, Harrogate HG11 3RP, passport number 189720339.

The Seller and the Buyer are together referred to as the Parties.

1. Subject Matter
The Seller agrees to sell and the Buyer agrees to purchase the used passenger motor car bearing vehicle registration YT22 UUW, together with all keys, accessories and documentation presently in Priya Patel's possession relating thereto.

2. Purchase Price and Payment
The agreed purchase price for the vehicle is £4,850. The Buyer shall pay the full purchase price by means of a single bank transfer to the Seller's nominated account, namely bank account (IBAN): GB39 YFKY 4708 0391 7252 97. The transfer shall be completed in cleared funds no later than 22 October 2026, and ownership shall not pass until the full amount has been received.

3. Condition and Sold as Seen
The Buyer acknowledges that she has inspected the vehicle, has had reasonable opportunity to arrange an independent inspection at her own expense, and purchases the vehicle sold as seen and with all faults, whether known or unknown. Ms Fairbanks accepts the present condition, age and wear of the vehicle. Save for title, no warranty, representation or undertaking is given by the Seller as to roadworthiness, fitness for purpose, quality or description. The Seller confirms that she is the lawful owner, that she has full authority to sell the vehicle, and that it is free from any third party claim of which she is aware.

4. Liability and Risk
Risk in the vehicle shall pass to the Buyer upon collection following receipt of payment. From that time, Ms Fairbanks shall be solely responsible for insurance, taxation and safe custody.

5. Entire Agreement
This document constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties concerning the sale.

Signed by the Seller:
Signature: ________________ Priya Patel Date: 20 October 2026

Signed by the Buyer:
Signature: ________________ Mia Fairbanks Date: 20 October 2026

THIS ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCY AGREEMENT is made on 15 May 2026 pursuant to the Housing Act 1988.

1. PARTIES
1.1 The Landlord is Harbourside Logistics LLP of 29 Victoria Street, Norwich NR7 8SJ acting through its lettings manager Eleanor Quinn.
1.2 The Tenant is Harry Kowalski whose date of birth is 1970-03-24 whose telephone number is 020 7946 0711 and whose e-mail address is harry.kowalski70@example.org.
1.3 Ms Quinn has authority to administer the letting and to serve notices on behalf of Harbourside Logistics LLP for the purposes of this Agreement.

2. PROPERTY
2.1 The Landlord lets to the Tenant the dwelling known as 144 Mill Road, Truro TR12 5PQ together with the fixtures and fittings therein and the rights of access and use of common parts as applicable.
2.2 The Tenant accepts the property in its present condition and acknowledges sole occupation for residential purposes only.

3. TERM
3.1 The fixed term shall be twelve months commencing at noon on 1 June 2026 and ending at noon on 31 May 2027.
3.2 If the Tenant remains in occupation after the fixed term with the Landlord's consent, a monthly periodic tenancy shall arise on the same terms, terminable by two months' written notice from the Landlord or one month's written notice from Mr Kowalski.

4. RENT
4.1 The rent shall be £895 per calendar month, payable monthly in advance on the first day of each month without deduction or set-off.
4.2 All payments of rent shall be made by bank transfer to the Landlord's account with IBAN GB72 VIXR 4967 2084 4881 14 quoting the property address as reference.
4.3 Interest at 3% per annum above base rate shall be payable on rent in arrears for more than fourteen days.

5. DEPOSIT
5.1 The Tenant has paid a deposit of £1,035 which the Landlord shall protect in an authorised deposit protection scheme within thirty days of receipt.
5.2 The deposit is held as security for performance of the Tenant's obligations and shall be returned, less lawful deductions for arrears, damage beyond fair wear and tear, and cleaning costs, within ten days of agreement of the final account.
5.3 Eleanor Quinn shall provide Harry Kowalski with the prescribed information relating to the protection of the deposit.

6. TENANT'S OBLIGATIONS
6.1 To keep the interior of the property in good and clean condition, to ventilate adequately, and to report disrepair promptly to Ms Quinn.
6.2 Not to sublet, assign or share occupation of the whole or any part of the property, nor to use the property for business purposes.
6.3 Not to keep pets, smoke indoors, or make alterations without prior written consent of Harbourside Logistics LLP.
6.4 To permit reasonable access for inspection and repair upon forty-eight hours' written notice.

SIGNED by the parties:
Landlord: Harbourside Logistics LLP, by Eleanor Quinn, Lettings Manager ........................ Date ............
Tenant: Harry Kowalski ........................ Date ............

This Private Sale Agreement is made on 24 October 2026 by and between the Seller and the Buyer in respect of the sale of a used motor vehicle.

1. Parties. The Seller is Olivia Winslow, born on 5 July 1967, residing at 26 Meadow Way, Harrogate HG2 2HJ. The Buyer is Arjun Morgan, residing at 105 Chapel Lane, Chester CH11 7UY, holding passport number 516185453. Ms Winslow agrees to sell and Mr Morgan agrees to purchase the Vehicle described below upon the terms of this Agreement.

2. Vehicle. The Seller agrees to sell one used passenger motor car bearing vehicle registration: SZ15 HJP. The Buyer confirms that he has inspected the Vehicle, has examined its exterior, interior, mileage as displayed, tyres, lights and documentation, and has had adequate opportunity to conduct a test drive prior to signature hereof.

3. Purchase Price and Payment. The agreed purchase price is £4,750. The full sum shall be paid by the Buyer to the Seller by bank transfer in pounds sterling to the Seller's account identified by IBAN GB28JJVD06339244026545. Title and risk in the Vehicle shall pass only upon receipt of the full cleared funds in the said account. The Seller acknowledges no other method of payment is accepted unless agreed in writing.

4. Condition and Sold as Seen. The Vehicle is sold as seen and with all faults, whether known or unknown. The Seller gives no warranty as to roadworthiness, mechanical condition, fitness for purpose or remaining lifespan of any part. The Buyer accepts that he relies solely upon his own inspection and judgement and shall have no claim for repair, refund or reduction in price after completion, save where the Seller has deliberately misrepresented ownership.

5. Ownership. The Seller warrants that she is the lawful owner of the Vehicle, that it is free from any loan secured thereon to her knowledge, and that she has full authority to sell it.

Signed by the Seller:
Olivia Winslow ____________________ Date: 24 October 2026

Signed by the Buyer:
Arjun Morgan ____________________ Date: 24 October 2026

ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCY AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 14 April 2026 between the Landlord and the Tenant named below and creates an assured shorthold tenancy.

1. PARTIES AND PROPERTY
1.1 The Landlord is Harbourside Joinery Limited
of 96 Park Avenue, Reading RG1 4WB
1.2 The Tenant is George Murphy
whose date of birth is 30 September 1952
whose telephone number is +44 7700 900461
and whose e-mail address is georgemurphy@example.net
1.3 The landlord's lettings manager is Siobhan Holloway
who shall act for Harbourside Joinery Limited in the administration of this tenancy.
1.4 The Landlord lets the dwelling at 152 Station Road, Norwich NR16 9SS
together with the fixtures and fittings therein.

2. TERM AND RENT
2.1 The fixed term shall be twelve months commencing on 1 May 2026 and ending on 30 April 2027.
2.2 The rent shall be £950 per calendar month, payable monthly in advance on the first day of each month.
2.3 The Tenant shall pay the rent by standing order to the Landlord's account with IBAN GB09 FUZB 1099 9118 9716 79
without deduction or set-off. The first payment shall be made on or before the commencement date.
2.4 If the rent remains unpaid for more than fourteen days after it falls due, interest shall be payable at three per cent per annum above the base rate.

3. DEPOSIT
3.1 The Tenant shall pay a deposit of £1,100 on the signing of this Agreement.
3.2 The Landlord shall protect the deposit in an authorised deposit protection scheme within thirty days of receipt and shall serve the prescribed information upon Mr Murphy. The deposit shall be returned at the end of the tenancy subject to any lawful deductions for arrears, damage beyond fair wear and tear, or breach of obligation.

4. TENANT'S OBLIGATIONS
4.1 Mr Murphy shall occupy the property as his principal home, keep it clean and in reasonable condition, and not sublet or part with possession.
4.2 The Tenant shall not cause nuisance or antisocial behaviour, shall not smoke inside the premises, and shall not keep pets without prior written consent.
4.3 The Tenant shall permit reasonable access upon at least twenty-four hours' written notice for inspection, repair and statutory compliance.
4.4 The Tenant shall pay all charges for electricity, gas, water and council services used during the tenancy and shall inform the lettings manager of any defect or damage without delay.

5. TERMINATION
After the fixed term the tenancy may continue as a monthly periodic tenancy terminable by two months' written notice from the Landlord or one month's written notice from the Tenant.

Signed for and on behalf of the Landlord:

Signature: ........................................ Date: ....................

Signed by the Tenant:

Signature: ........................................ Date: ....................
George Murphy
